n: 7.4 Cu. Ft. Smart Front Load Gas Dryer With Ai Sensor Dry & Turbosteam™ Technology
desc: This LG dryer is designed to put time back on your side. When there's no time to wash, quick and easy TurboSteam technology refreshes clothes and eases wrinkles in just 10 minutes.
hl: Eliminate the Guesswork with Sensor Dry
Built-in sensors & AI technology detect fabric texture, load size, and moisture to automatically adjusts drying time - for more advanced fabric care and energy savings.
Steam Refresh Clothes in Between Washes
In just 10 minutes TurboSteam™ technology reduces wrinkles in up to 5 garments¹ and SteamFresh™ cycle reduces odors² when you don’t have time to wash.
The award-winning⁵ modern flat front design, black steel finish and tinted, tempered glass doors bring a premium point of view to your laundry space.
The intuitive digital dial control gives you more information with each turn.
LG closet-depth⁶ dryers have a shallower depth to fit in more places & add sleek style to any room.
When space is tight, the reversible door can go from right swing to left to fit almost any space.
